additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0447347 ﻿from the
Technical Support
to the
eMobility RC-
BE
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
X
Onsite Troubleshooting
X
End Customer Communication
X
Spare Part Ordering
Performance monitoring by RC
I have already updated the charger from v6 to v7 as requested by customer.
There is a fault in the charger after dispenser commissioning. DC3 and DC4 have a permanent fast shutdown command and can't perform the converter grouping.
You can check this measuring if we have permanent 12V DC on the output of KF214 fastshutdown command.
If this behavior confirms, please replace the state monitor from dispenser, KF214.
I'm assigning this ticket to your queue but let me know if my support is needed for the intervention. I will be available to support.
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-
BE
SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
.
If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution and send survey email to the customer.
Thank you.

change

replying
to it.
